purpose: Design phase of the neural committee member. Choose the network's preprocessing, architecture and training budget BEFORE any declaration or development score.

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_nn.py --fold design: fit on the seasonal fold's fit partition (2025-02..06, 08, 09; LIRF excluded, as the committee), monitor on its early-stop partition (2025-10, LIRF excluded). October is the partition every committee learner already used for early stopping.
protocol.never_read: No design run predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11 or 2025-12 (the four recipe months) or the ranking months. The seasonal/forward score partitions and December are first used by the declared development round.
protocol.readings: Per variant: October RMSE of the network on the monitored rows (non-LIRF), its per-epoch curve, and the RMSE of (1 - a) * committee + a * network for a in 0.1..0.6, where committee is the incumbent ens_v20_bag_q_all rebuilt from its members' seasonal-fold models on October (tools/nn_committee_october.py). Those committee models used October for early stopping, so the blend reading is conservative for the network.
protocol.decision: The declaration fixes the variant with the best October blend reading at its best weight, after at most two design rounds; it may also fix a second variant only if the two are both within 0.02% of the best blend reading and their October predictions correlate below 0.99.

features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)
